findings.label: Budget wrap-up sends a contradictory instruction
findings.detail: On a budget-exceeded last step a free-choice worker gets budgetFinalNote ('Do not call any more tools') while toolChoice simultaneously forces report_result. Behaviour is correct (the loop ends on a structured result), but the note text contradicts the forced choice. Consider a worker-specific wrap-up note when forceFinalTool is set.

findings.label: Worker types temporarily home in worker.ts
findings.detail: WorkerStatus/WorkerResult/WorkerRecord live in worker.ts with an in-code note that Task 8.1 re-homes them to lib/types.ts. Tracked by the spec; flagged so the move isn't forgotten.
